Lemma
[Duhamel's principle on a closed manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0417 1. appe:1.9\group Heat Kernels

For $\square =\partial _t-\Delta $, smooth $A,B$ on a closed manifold satisfy \[ \int _{t_1}^{t_2}\! \int _M[-(\square A)(w,t-s)B+A(w,t-s)(\square B)] =\int _M[A(w,t-t_2)B(w,t_2)-A(w,t-t_1)B(w,t_1)]. \]
